dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Wow—

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: It's beautiful.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'm so glad you like it! When I saw this view before, I just knew I had to find a chance to bring you here to see it too.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: I like it a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: But...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: What's wrong? Did we have to walk too far to see it?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: No...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Are you hungry then? Or thirsty? I've got coconut milk in my bag. Would you like some?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: It's not that...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: It's okay, Qiqi. I'm here. I'm listening. Just take your time.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: I'll forget this place soon...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Yeah, I know.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: I can only remember things I can write down.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Things I can't write, I can't remember.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: I was so happy today, but if I can't write it down, I'll forget.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: The color of the leaves, the whirling wind, and your hand, Yaoyao.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: I'll only remember... your name.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: That's good enough.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: There, there.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: ...Huh? H—Hand...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't you worry, Qiqi. I've got a great memory — I can remember all the phrases that Master teaches me to remember spear moves after only a few repetitions.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Also, Yanfei's taught me some super cool, um, "associative mnemonics."

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: For example, some of the leaves we saw today were golden, like the bells on my head, and others were green, like the White Jade Radishes in my basket.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Leave all the things you can't remember with me. I won't forget them — I promise.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Besides, this isn't the only time we'll visit this place! We can come every month, or drop by whenever we feel like it.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Master always says that "diligence can make up for a lack of talent." We'll just visit this place more often... and who knows? You might just be able to remember it.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: R—Really?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Of course! Master said so, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I'm not sure if that saying applies here. Oh well, as long as they're having fun...)

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Or... Hmm, did I use the saying wrong again?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: I don't know, but I believe you, Yaoyao.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Then let's make a pinky promise! I'm Streetward Rambler's disciple, and my word is as good as my bond.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Okay... I will, write this down.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (This area is safe. I'll spend some more time with them before the sun sets.)

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Ah, right. Try this, Yaoyao.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Oh? You cooked a meal too? Hmm. I do happen to be feeling a little hungry...

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Mmm. I... wrote this one down.
